row.task_instruction: Analyze the classification performance of an automatic modulation classification (AMC) system by processing confusion matrix data from CNN-based models with transfer learning. Load the confusion matrix file "pred_confusion_mat_L100.npy" from the benchmark/datasets/Automatic-Modulation-Classification/Part6_CNN with Transfer Learning on AMC/ directory structure, which contains classification results across different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) levels ranging from -10 dB to 20 dB in 2 dB increments. Calculate the classification accuracy (Pc) at each SNR level by extracting the diagonal elements of the confusion matrices and normalizing by the total number of test samples. Generate a line plot showing the relationship between SNR and classification accuracy, and save the visualization as "pred_results/pred_plot_acc_L100.png". Additionally, save the numerical results containing both SNR values and corresponding accuracy values to "pred_results/pred_plot_acc.txt" in a two-row format where the first row contains SNR values and the second row contains accuracy values.
